deskyard account list: list the accounts

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] account list [--json]

Lists the accounts, shares included, with their kind (password or token),
access, expiry and last sign-in.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: a table USER KIND ACCESS EXPIRES LAST-SIGN-IN NOTE; with --json the
  API's [Account]

Examples:
  deskyard account list

Where: on this machine, talking to the chosen server: the one -e SERVER/ (or -e SERVER/ENV) names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
